signals.claim: AI-driven server orders and high-capacity DRAM demand were running above prior expectations in early March 2025, while DDR5/server-memory bandwidth remained a real workload bottleneck.

evidence.summary: TrendForce said North-American and Chinese CSP AI demand was pushing server growth above prior forecasts, with stronger server orders and high-capacity DRAM demand; server DDR5 pricing was expected to stabilize and potentially strengthen later in 2025.

A technical LocalLLaMA discussion explicitly treated memory bandwidth as a limiting factor for large-model inference. This is weak/anecdotal evidence used only as a usage-side discovery signal, not confirmation of supplier earnings.

contraryEvidence.summary: TrendForce also showed that broad enterprise SSD pricing remained under pressure and procurement growth was constrained, so the thesis should be specific to server-memory/interconnect demand rather than a blanket AI-storage boom.

causalChain: AI/CSP server growth -> more server memory capacity and bandwidth per platform
DDR5 penetration plus higher-memory-bandwidth server designs -> more advanced memory-interface and module-support chips
suppliers already in major memory-vendor/server ecosystems can monetize through unit growth and richer product mix
earnings capture requires proven scale shipments, not generic semiconductor adjacency
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: A supplier whose chips are mandatory in DDR5 server memory modules, already shipping at scale to major memory vendors, gaining from DDR5 generation migration and higher-bandwidth AI/server architectures, with earnings growth visible before the cutoff and valuation not requiring implausible penetration.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Potentially expands with server-memory module volumes, DDR5 generation migration and richer high-performance interconnect content.
opportunityAssessment.duration: Structural multi-year if AI/general-server deployment and DDR5/MRDIMM adoption continue.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: The AI/server theme was widely known, so the opportunity depends on company-specific product content and earnings acceleration exceeding what valuation already embeds.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: How much of the 2025 server-demand upgrade translates into incremental interface-chip units/mix rather than being captured elsewhere in the memory stack.

candidates.name: 澜起科技
candidates.economicExposure: A January 23, 2025 company investor record said 2024 DDR5 memory-interface demand was strong, DDR5 interface-chip shipments exceeded DDR4, and PCIe Retimer, MRCD/MDB and CKD had begun scale shipment. MRCD/MDB had been procured at scale by major global memory vendors.
candidates.monetization: The company expected 2024 revenue around RMB3.639bn (+59.2%) and attributable net profit RMB1.378-1.438bn (+205.6% to +218.9%). DDR5 third-generation RCD had started scale shipment and high-performance interconnect products were adding new growth.
earningsBridge: higher DDR5/server-memory capacity and bandwidth requirements
more RCD / MRCD-MDB / PMIC-SPD-TS / Retimer content and shipments
gross profit and net profit growth

basisReconciliation.externalIndicator: AI/server order growth and high-capacity DDR5 demand.
basisReconciliation.companyRealizedBasis: Company pre-cutoff disclosures directly tied 2024 growth to global server recovery, DDR5 penetration and scale shipment of high-performance interconnect chips to major memory vendors.
basisReconciliation.basisRisk: Server demand does not map one-for-one to every product; unit content, customer mix, platform timing and ASP can change.

candidates.balanceSheetCycle: The company had a strong net-cash style balance sheet and the thesis is product-cycle/content driven rather than inventory-price speculation.
candidates.competitiveQuality: The company described itself as the lead contributor to DDR5 RCD standards and had major memory-vendor procurement for MRCD/MDB, suggesting qualification/standards advantages rather than concept-only exposure.

horizonBridge.expectedHalfLife: Several years if DDR5 generations, MRDIMM and AI/server memory-bandwidth requirements keep expanding, though individual product ramps can be lumpy.
normalizationIndicators: server-order forecasts are revised down materially
major memory-vendor procurement or scale shipment slows
revenue/profit growth decouples from product shipment growth
valuation begins to require unrealistic multi-year growth
horizonBridge.whyHorizonMatches: The thesis depends on multi-quarter platform adoption and product-generation migration, not a one-off news repricing.

candidates.priceExpectation: Pending deterministic pre-signal price/market-cap enrichment; cannot exceed Watch until the valuation/expectation bridge is completed.
contraryEvidence: AI/server demand was already a crowded market narrative by March 2025.
Broad NAND/enterprise-SSD conditions were still soft, showing that not every server-adjacent semiconductor product was benefiting.
Very high 2024 profit growth created a difficult comparison base and raised the risk that valuation already capitalized much of the good news.
thesisBreakers: DDR5/MRDIMM adoption or server orders materially miss the pre-cutoff industry trajectory
major memory vendors slow procurement of the company's higher-value products
new interconnect products fail to become material despite scale-shipment claims
the pre-signal share price implies a profit level/duration that requires near-perfect execution
unansweredQuestions: What earnings level was embedded in the March 11 share price?
How much 2025 growth could be supported by existing products before relying on new product optionality?

pointInTimeEvidence.summary: January 23 investor call: 2024 revenue expected around RMB3.639bn; attributable profit RMB1.378-1.438bn; DDR5 shipments exceeded DDR4; third-gen RCD and high-performance interconnect products entered scale shipment.

candidates.name: 深南电路
candidates.economicExposure: Pre-cutoff company disclosures identified data centers (including servers) as a key PCB target market. 2024Q3 company research said data-center PCB revenue increased sequentially as general-server demand recovered, while AI acceleration and server recovery improved product mix; a Feb. 7, 2025 record confirmed continued data-center/server focus and HDI capability.
candidates.monetization: 2024Q1-Q3 revenue was RMB13.049bn (+37.92%) and attributable net profit RMB1.488bn (+63.86%). The company had both PCB and package-substrate exposure to servers/storage, with ongoing capacity/technology expansion.
earningsBridge: higher-value server/data-center PCB and package-substrate demand
net profit and operating cash flow

basisReconciliation.externalIndicator: Upward-revised server orders and high-capacity memory/server buildout.
basisReconciliation.companyRealizedBasis: Company disclosures before the cutoff directly showed data-center/server applications, sequential data-center PCB growth in 2024Q3 and strong 2024Q1-Q3 revenue/profit growth.
basisReconciliation.basisRisk: The company is diversified across communications, auto, PCB, substrates and assembly; AI/server demand is material but not the whole earnings base.

candidates.balanceSheetCycle: Capacity expansion and substrate ramp require capital, but 2024Q1-Q3 operating cash flow remained positive. The thesis is mix/utilization driven rather than commodity inventory.
candidates.competitiveQuality: High-end PCB, HDI and package-substrate capabilities plus large-scale manufacturing and customer qualification provide a stronger economic link than generic server-adjacent suppliers.

horizonBridge.expectedHalfLife: Several years if AI/server architecture and high-speed networking continue to raise PCB complexity/value content, with quarterly lumpiness from capacity and customer programs.
normalizationIndicators: high-speed networking/server PCB mix stops improving
valuation requires sustained growth beyond plausible capacity/earnings
horizonBridge.whyHorizonMatches: The thesis depends on multi-quarter customer programs, PCB complexity upgrades and capacity utilization rather than a one-time policy shock.

candidates.priceExpectation: Pending deterministic pre-signal price and valuation enrichment.
contraryEvidence: The company has meaningful non-server businesses, diluting pure AI exposure.
Package-substrate capacity ramp can pressure margin before utilization improves.
Server/AI demand was already a popular market narrative by March 2025.
thesisBreakers: server/data-center PCB orders fail to keep growing
new capacity utilization or customer qualification disappoints
margin improvement stalls despite revenue growth
pre-signal valuation already discounts the expected earnings path
unansweredQuestions: How much incremental 2025 profit can data-center/server products move at the cutoff?
Which of PCB versus package-substrate economics is the dominant earnings bridge?

pointInTimeEvidence.summary: 2024Q1-Q3 revenue RMB13.049bn (+37.92%), attributable net profit RMB1.488bn (+63.86%); company linked growth to AI acceleration and server-demand recovery.
Company reaffirmed data centers/servers as a key PCB target and described HDI capability and server/storage package-substrate products.

signals.claim: China signaled a return to crude-steel output reduction in 2025 as part of an industry restructuring effort, but the reduction amount was not yet specified and end-demand remained weak.

evidence.summary: Reuters reported that China planned to cut crude-steel output in 2025 to address overcapacity and restructure the industry, but no official reduction target had yet been announced.

contraryEvidence.summary: Reuters analysis emphasized weak property-linked steel demand and modest stimulus, so supply discipline did not automatically imply a strong steel-price cycle.

causalChain: policy-driven production discipline -> potential reduction in industry oversupply
less destructive price competition -> possible margin stabilization for efficient producers
weak property/end demand can still offset supply cuts
benefit should concentrate in low-cost, differentiated producers rather than the entire steel sector
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: A low-cost, high-end-product steelmaker with strong balance sheet, industry-leading profitability and product differentiation that can preserve margin if output discipline improves, without relying on a large demand rebound.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Could shift toward efficient producers if supply discipline is real, but total profit pool may stay weak if demand contracts.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: Potentially interesting because sector profitability was depressed, but the size and enforcement of cuts were unknown.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: Whether output cuts are large/credible enough to improve industry spreads before weak demand absorbs the benefit.

candidates.name: 宝钢股份
candidates.economicExposure: 2024Q1-Q3 profit before tax was RMB8.23bn and remained industry-leading; differentiated products and cost reduction supported resilience despite depressed steel margins.
candidates.monetization: If industry output discipline improves spreads, a low-cost high-end producer can benefit disproportionately; however 2024Q3 steel manufacturing gross margin was only about 3%, showing how severe the demand/price pressure remained.
earningsBridge: less industry oversupply / better steel spread
high-end mix plus cost leadership preserves volume/margin

basisReconciliation.companyRealizedBasis: Company-specific 2024Q3 disclosures showed industry-leading profit, strong differentiated-product growth and cost reduction, but very low steel-manufacturing margin.
basisReconciliation.basisRisk: Policy quantity/enforcement was not known and demand weakness could dominate any supply effect.

candidates.balanceSheetCycle: Large integrated producer with scale and cash-flow resilience, but working capital/raw-material spreads remain cyclical.
candidates.competitiveQuality: Industry-leading profitability, high-end product mix and large cost-reduction program are favorable if sector consolidation occurs.

horizonBridge.expectedHalfLife: Several quarters if production cuts are implemented, but the thesis can fail quickly if demand weakens or cuts are not enforced.
normalizationIndicators: official cut target is small or delayed
horizonBridge.whyHorizonMatches: Any benefit must pass through industry supply, spreads and quarterly producer margins rather than a multi-year technology adoption curve.

candidates.priceExpectation: Watch only because the size/enforcement of the policy shock was not known at the cutoff.
contraryEvidence: No official output-cut quantity had been specified.
The company's steel manufacturing gross margin had compressed materially in 2024.
thesisBreakers: output cuts prove symbolic or poorly enforced
steel demand contracts faster than supply
raw-material or export frictions offset spread improvement
unansweredQuestions: What cut magnitude and enforcement mechanism would be required to move sector spreads materially?

finalDecision.noTradeReason: NO TRADE. Policy direction is potentially positive, but the quantity/enforcement and demand-side offset were too uncertain at the cutoff.

signals.claim: The DRC's four-month cobalt export suspension had just begun, creating a sharp supply-policy shock intended to counter global cobalt oversupply.

evidence.summary: Reuters reported a four-month cobalt export suspension effective February 22, introduced by DRC authorities to counter oversupply and support market pricing.

contraryEvidence.summary: The suspension was a response to oversupply rather than evidence of a demand boom; it could also prevent DRC producers from monetizing output while the ban remained active.

causalChain: DRC export suspension -> near-term seaborne cobalt availability tightens
cobalt price may stabilize or rise
DRC producers simultaneously face shipment/working-capital constraints
a clean equity beneficiary requires non-DRC supply or downstream economics that gain from price without losing volume
signals.beneficiaryArchetype: A producer with meaningful cobalt supply outside the DRC, or a company whose margins improve from cobalt repricing without being blocked by the export suspension, with material earnings exposure and acceptable valuation.

opportunityAssessment.profitPoolChange: Ambiguous: price support may help resource owners, but the policy directly restricts shipment from the dominant producing region.
opportunityAssessment.duration: Four months initially, subject to review.
opportunityAssessment.expectationGap: The supply shock was sudden, but direct DRC producers face a two-sided earnings effect.
opportunityAssessment.keyUncertainty: Whether price gains outweigh export/volume restrictions and whether non-DRC supply is material enough to capture the shortage.

finalDecision.noTradeReason: NO TRADE. The cleanest large DRC cobalt producer in the existing research set is quarantined, and the policy simultaneously raises price while restricting shipment; no uncontaminated A-share beneficiary with a cleaner earnings bridge was established.
